name: Phone laugh to gym lock-in
description: A static-camera single-take gym reaction in which a seated subject laughs at a phone, abruptly becomes serious, puts the phone down, and grips the next exercise handle.
lockedGrammar: One uninterrupted natural-real-time take from a locked vertical phone camera
Subject begins seated at an exercise station and laughs while looking at a phone
Laughter snaps abruptly to a focused deadpan expression at the midpoint
Subject puts the phone aside, turns toward the equipment, plants both feet, and grips the handle
Hair, loose clothing, equipment, reflections, and background patrons retain causal secondary motion
Hook caption is deterministic and disappears before the final equipment setup

variables.description: A fictional or authorized identity used for the entire take.
variables.defaultValue: a clearly new fictional young adult woman with a consistent face and hair
examples: a fictional blonde woman with a loose high ponytail
a fictional Black woman with shoulder-length twists

variables.description: Gender presentation preserved unless the user explicitly changes it.
Loose gym clothing that visibly responds to the seated turn and foot placement.
variables.defaultValue: a dark sleeveless workout top, oversized light-grey sweatpants, and white trainers
examples: a black cropped tee with grey joggers
a green tank with loose black sweatpants

variables.description: A busy exercise setting with a seated station and subtle background activity.
variables.defaultValue: a commercial gym with a red brick wall, mirrors, cable machines, a seated row bench, and moving background patrons
examples: a brick-wall commercial gym at a seated row station
a community gym at a leg-extension station

variables.description: The handheld object that causes the opening laugh and is put aside before the set.
examples: an unbranded phone with a dark case

variables.defaultValue: when you just saw the funniest video of your life on your fyp but it's time to lock in for your next set
examples: when the group chat is hilarious but your rest timer is over
when the meme is elite but it's time for the next set

variables.description: Authorized or replacement audio aligned to the laugh-to-focus switch.
variables.defaultValue: a rights-safe exaggerated laugh followed by an abrupt focused beat
examples: new comic laughter that cuts to a heavy focus sound

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: Create {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation seated sideways at an exercise station in {{setting}}, wearing {{wardrobe}}, laughing at {{phone_prop}}. Preserve the locked vertical phone framing, cool even gym light, visible exercise handle and natural background activity.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: In one uninterrupted locked-camera take at natural real-time speed, {{subject_identity}} laughs hard at {{phone_prop}} for the opening half, abruptly snaps to a serious focused expression, puts the phone aside, rotates toward the equipment, plants both feet, leans forward and grips the exercise handle by the end. Keep identity and {{wardrobe}} stable; preserve causal hair, loose-fabric, equipment, reflection and background-patron motion.

deterministicLayers.template: Render exact text ‘{{caption_text}}’ in four centered upper-frame lines using heavy rounded white sans-serif with a black outline.
Use this audio policy: {{audio_policy}}. Align the abrupt laugh-to-focus change to the subject's expression switch.

promptExamples: Use the phone-laugh-to-lock-in format with a blonde woman at a seated row and keep the original caption.
Recreate the lock-in reaction with a man at a leg-extension machine and caption it ‘when the group chat is funny but rest time is over’.
